sampling_stratum: agent-owned fortress city, walls/moat and communication or outdoor courier
source: general knowledge and supplied reference only; no local candidate data

choices.concept: A mud-spattered dispatch courier reaches the city drawbridge as the gate is being secured; the sealed message makes a pause in the closure consequential.
choices.comparison: Direct relationship between courier and gate, but another guard or moving bridge could compete with facial continuity and flintlock legibility.

choices.concept: A wall-top signal courier locks a luminous coded dispatch into a hand-carried lantern at the moat-facing parapet while a distant answering lamp appears across the water.
choices.comparison: A quiet person-centered transition with local hand-object contact and a visible distant response; layered fortress and moat establish the scale of communication.

choices.concept: A river-gate messenger pauses at a low stone landing, holding a dispatch cylinder above spray while an empty ferry settles against the ring beside the city wall.
choices.comparison: Strong tactile struggle with water and transport, but boat mechanics and wide distance may dilute the flintlock and fantasy identifiers.
